assessments.reasoning: The four verified publisher ranges identify the material and source form, connect the condition to the grants and state both the preservation rule and its correction exception. Section 3.4 expressly includes warranty disclaimers among the protected examples.

challenge.method: Compared correcting a demonstrably mistaken name in a covered-source copyright notice with deleting an accurate warranty disclaimer in the same edit.
challenge.results: Correcting the name can fall within the exception to the extent required. The unrelated deletion changes protected substance and gains no permission from the factual error elsewhere.

limitations: The location and substance of the notice matter. Section 3.4 alone does not establish a byte-for-byte preservation rule or a rule for every statement displayed by an executable.
reasoning: Section 3.4 protects the substance of license notices within covered source. It allows the alteration necessary to remedy a known factual error. Section 2.7 makes section 3.4 a condition of the section 2.1 grants.
